name: mpg123
input_api: mpg123_open_feed(mh); mpg123_feed(mh, local bytes, size); mpg123_decode_frame() until MPG123_NEED_MORE; mpg123_getformat(); mpg123_info2()
scope: Every MPEG Layer III frame of an untagged stream fed from memory and decoded: sample rate, channels, layer, frame count, decoded samples per channel
family_note: Same libmpg123 engine as the mp3_id3v2/c mpg123 entry and the decoder behind libsndfile, SDL2_mixer and LAME HIP paths there; this record covers plain frame decoding through the feed API, not ID3v2.
